osm.note: No free official chart exists for Croatia. Land, piers, berths and marks: OpenStreetMap / OpenSeaMap (ODbL). Depths in the harbour: the published figures below; elsewhere EMODnet.

depths.name: City port (ferry and catamaran berths)
depths.src: Quay depth 10.5 m (MedCruise, Port of Split); berth sections 7 to 10 m (MarineLink port profile)

depths.name: Outer side of the breakwater (cruise berths)
depths.src: Two cruise berths on the outer side of the breakwater, ships to 320 m and 270 m, draught 10.5 m (MedCruise); approach channel 12.5 to 13.7 m (Searates)
